fact: ANID states that it maintains the Central National Biometric Identification Database and the Social Register of Individuals and Households (RSPM).
system: Social Register of Individuals and Households (RSPM)

fact: Togo's presentation says the RSPM social registry was in development and initial integration in 2025, with full-scale operation planned for 2026.
The World Bank says Togo has operationalised a dynamic social registry (RSPM) that its e-ID feeds.
The World Bank says the e-ID system is fully interoperable with the RSPM, enabling automatic ingestion of unique identification numbers.
